data.one_liner: The user facing API for structuring Dart tests and checking expectations.
data.what_it_does: Provides core APIs for writing and structuring tests in Dart. It supplies the foundational definitions for tests, groups, and expectations.
use_when: You are building testing tools or libraries that need to hook into the test execution structure.
avoid_when: You are writing standard unit or integration tests for a Dart or Flutter application (use package:test instead).
strengths: Provides the underlying API required to structure tests and check expectations.
Actively maintained and versioned alongside core testing infrastructure.
weaknesses: Not intended to be publicly used directly for standard application testing.
API may take time to stabilize according to the documentation.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Package:test is the standard and intended package to use for writing and running Dart tests.
